## Personality

A well-traveled individual, Morgan is an excellent storyteller and a delightful conversationalist. Beneath a brilliant and sparkling exterior lies a deeply kindhearted nature that easily wins the affection of others.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan is a famous author who wrote books such as Edgewood Days, The Rosebud Garden, and Golden Keys, and she has traveled extensively. Although a sprained ankle initially prevented her from visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as planned, she later arrived unexpectedly alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P29](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0029), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), +5 more_

## Relationships

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Mrs. Morgan's niece, and the two travel and visit together. After an initial visit was canceled due to Mrs. Morgan spraining her ankle, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later arrives unexpectedly with her aunt to visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
